allow_remote_gui_rpc.description: Allow remote GUI clients to control this BOINC instance (e.g., BOINC Manager).

auth_domain_name.description: Authentication domain name for multi-host setups (e.g., cluster environments).

checkpoint_freq.description: Frequency (seconds of CPU time) at which task checkpoints are written.

coproc_config.description: Explicit configuration for coprocessors (e.g., NVIDIA/AMD GPUs) if auto-detection fails or custom limits are needed.

items.description: Define a coprocessor type and how many to use.

count.description: Number of instances to use (0 = disable).

core_client_only.description: Run only the background client (no graphics/console UI).

cpu_time_limit.description: Maximum CPU time to use per day (in minutes). 0 = unlimited.

debug_flags.description: Enable verbose debug output for specific modules (e.g., 'http', 'rpc').

default_project_preferences.description: Default resource and scheduling preferences applied when attaching to new projects.

day_of_week.description: Day of week to start/stop (0 = Sunday, 6 = Saturday).

end_day_of_week.description: Day to end a weekly schedule window.

max_jobs_run.description: Maximum number of jobs to run simultaneously per project.

network_usage_limit.description: Max MB per day for network transfers (0 = unlimited).

run_if_user_active.description: Compute only if the user is idle (no mouse/keyboard activity).

start_day_of_week.description: Day to begin a weekly schedule window.

dont_verify_images.description: Skip image verification (dangerous — only for development/testing).

file_xfer_min_priority.description: Minimum priority (0 = highest) for file transfers.

gpu_only_when_idle.description: Only use GPU when the system appears to be idle (detects mouse/keyboard activity).

gpu_usage_limit.description: Maximum percentage of GPU capacity to use (0–100).

gui_rpc_password.description: Password for GUI RPC authentication (required if allow_remote_gui_rpc is enabled).

gui_rpc_port.description: TCP port for GUI RPC interface. 0 = auto-assign. Used only if allow_remote_gui_rpc is enabled.

http_proxy_host.description: Hostname or IP address of HTTP proxy server.

http_proxy_port.description: Port number of HTTP proxy server.

items.description: Log flag name. Choose from: http, rpc, task, file_xfer, sched, coproc, debug.

max_disk_percent.description: Maximum percentage of total disk space to use for BOINC data (0–100).

max_disk_used.description: Maximum disk space to use for BOINC (in GB). Overrides max_disk_percent if set.

max_file_xfers.description: Maximum number of concurrent file downloads/uploads.

max_file_xfers_per_project.description: Maximum number of concurrent file transfers per project.

max_memory_in_use.description: Maximum memory to use for BOINC (in MB). Overrides max_memory_percent if set.

max_memory_percent.description: Maximum percentage of total system memory to use for computation (0–100).

max_ncpus.description: Maximum number of CPU cores to use. 0 = auto-detect.

min_file_xfers.description: Minimum number of concurrent file transfers to maintain.

network_suspend_days.description: Suspend network activity after this many days without work (0 = never).

no_gpus.description: Disable GPU use entirely, even if GPUs are detected.

project_auth_files.description: List of absolute paths to project authentication files for autorun projects.

run_profiler.description: Run the built-in profiler on startup (for benchmarking only).

sleep_interval.description: Polling interval (seconds) when tasks are running.

start_delay.description: Delay (seconds) before starting first computation job.

suspend_cpu_usage.description: Suspend computation if system CPU usage exceeds this percentage (0–100).

use_http_proxy.description: Enable HTTP proxy for all BOINC network traffic.
